recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If GenomicStudy is reintroduced to the active core build, preserve the existing data-format CodeSystem, ValueSet, and input/output type bindings rather than reworking this issue.
issue_request: Published Clinical Genomics R5 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for terminology support on GenomicStudy.analysis.input.type and GenomicStudy.analysis.output.type by adding a data-format CodeSystem/ValueSet with example codes and example bindings.
initial_application: The request was partially applied by commit 5f1e5c87e79e with inline input/output examples, then substantively applied through PR #2116 (merge ff7c5cbbec68) with commits that added the genomicstudy-dataformat CodeSystem, the genomicstudy-dataformat ValueSet, and example bindings on both GenomicStudy.analysis.input.type and GenomicStudy.analysis.output.type.
additional_context: The retained GenomicStudy source still contains both example bindings to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/genomicstudy-dataformat, and the R5 published GenomicStudy profile exposes the same bindings. Current source/fhir.ini has no active GenomicStudy resource entries after the 2025 remove-additional-resources commit, so edits to that retained source would not affect the current core build.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source was changed because the R5 request is already reflected in source/published artifacts and the affected resource is outside current core build scope.
